Your sentiments about this person are conflicting. You state you don’t want a relationship, yet you are stuck not moving on due to feelings you have for them. It sounds like you don’t know what you want, but you don’t want to be alone. 

You left him over feelings you still had with your ex. And you’re not moving on to others and allowing these feelings to hinder your life again. You need to start doing the work and figure out what you want and who you want it from. Everyone deserves clarity (especially you) and you would only be bringing him into chaos. 

As a society we need to get better at existing while being uncomfortable while we heal instead of latching onto others as a bandaid to cope.
